question: Current validation probes sample logit-normal times and rarely cover the lastODE time0.98. Measure fixed-time velocity and true-zero endpoint residuals; compare inference precision with identical mature weights and compare time encodings only between matched short pilots.
hypotheses: Late-time extrapolation may leave continuous near-zero residuals even when mean metrics look good.
BF16 inference precision may contribute; compare fullFP32 without changing BF16 training.
Scalar expression encoder gain may affect resolution near zero; record a CPU-FP32 finite-difference gain.
caveat: Denoising dependence, not generation performance. Analytic oracle verifies equations, not attainable Bayes risk. MainEMA versus raw pilots have unequal maturity; only same-weight precision and same-budget time-scale comparisons are paired.
